definitions.ask: Should doctl_login refuse a token that grants more than recovery needs?
definitions.why: athena was compromised on 2026-10-17; its token should do only what recovery needs

choices.label: Tokens with any extra non-read scope (droplet:delete, write, ...) are never saved
Over-scoped tokens are saved after a yellow warning naming the extra scopes

definitions.ask: Should Apollo's recovery runbook tell you to run doctl_login instead of hand-running doctl auth init?
definitions.why: The runbook is where you look mid-outage; the script checks scopes manual steps never verify

definitions.ask: Should the tailnet memory note say doctl_login sets up the token and agents may run it bare as a read-only check?
